details: It uses a Grasp Quality Convolutional Neural Network to learn how to grasp unusually shaped objects.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. And that shape of the machine — DexNet — is what makes everything else possible.
